reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Arkansas
    Focus year: 2021
    Question: Whether the term 'Writ of recovery of premises and order to vacate'
              is used to refer to the court-to-authorities order to remove a tenant.

    Statutes encoded:
    - AR Code  18-16-506 (2020)
*/

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Basic jurisdiction/context facts
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

jurisdiction_state(arkansas).
focus_year(2021).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Scenario (question) facts + scenario_statement/0
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* The question asks about the meaning/usage of a specific term. */
scenario_query_term('writ of recovery of premises and order to vacate').

/* The meaning proposed in the question: "order from the court to the authorities
   to remove a tenant". We'll model that as the concept of an eviction writ directed
   to law enforcement commanding the defendant to vacate. */
scenario_target_concept(eviction_writ_to_law_enforcement_to_vacate).

/* Minimal example eviction case facts (not required to answer terminology,
   but included to encode the idea of the writ described by the statute). */
scenario_defendant(defendant_1).
scenario_plaintiff(plaintiff_1).
scenario_served(defendant_1).
scenario_qualifying_days_since_service(defendant_1, 5).
/* No scenario_filed_written_objection_within_5_days(defendant_1). */

/* A sample writ issued in the scenario */
scenario_writ(writ_1).
scenario_writ_type(writ_1, writ_of_possession).
scenario_writ_directed_to(writ_1, sheriff).
scenario_writ_command(writ_1, cause_defendant_to_vacate_without_delay).

/* Helper predicate that succeeds when the factual statement (scenario) is present. */
scenario_statement :-
    jurisdiction_state(arkansas),
    focus_year(2021),
    scenario_query_term(_),
    scenario_target_concept(eviction_writ_to_law_enforcement_to_vacate),
    scenario_defendant(defendant_1),
    scenario_served(defendant_1),
    scenario_qualifying_days_since_service(defendant_1, Days),
    Days >= 0,
    scenario_writ(writ_1),
    scenario_writ_type(writ_1, writ_of_possession),
    scenario_writ_directed_to(writ_1, sheriff),
    scenario_writ_command(writ_1, cause_defendant_to_vacate_without_delay).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Term normalization utilities (deterministic)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* normalize_term(+RawAtom, -CanonicalAtom)
   Converts known textual phrases into canonical term atoms. */
normalize_term('writ of possession', writ_of_possession) :- !.
normalize_term('writ of recovery of premises and order to vacate',
               writ_of_recovery_of_premises_and_order_to_vacate) :- !.
normalize_term(Other, Other) :-
    atom(Other),
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute translation: AR Code  18-16-506 (2020)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* We record which legal terms are used (named) in the statute text.
   This supports answering whether a particular term is "used to refer to" a concept. */
statute_18_16_506_term_used(arkansas, writ_of_possession) :- !.

/* AR Code  18-16-506 (2020)(a)
   If within five days (excluding Sundays/legal holidays) after service the defendant
   has not filed a written objection, the clerk shall immediately issue a writ of
   possession directed to sheriff/police chief commanding to cause defendant to vacate. */

statute_18_16_506_threshold_days(5) :- !.

statute_18_16_506_no_objection_within_5_days(Defendant) :-
    scenario_served(Defendant),
    scenario_qualifying_days_since_service(Defendant, Days),
    statute_18_16_506_threshold_days(Threshold),
    Days >= Threshold,
    \+ scenario_filed_written_objection_within_5_days(Defendant).

statute_18_16_506_clerk_must_issue_writ_of_possession(Defendant) :-
    statute_18_16_506_no_objection_within_5_days(Defendant).

/* AR Code  18-16-506 (2020)(b)(1)-(3)
   If a timely written objection is filed, a hearing is required; if the court finds
   plaintiff entitled, the court orders the clerk to immediately issue a writ of possession
   to sheriff/police chief to evict defendants. */

statute_18_16_506_hearing_required_if_objection(Defendant) :-
    scenario_served(Defendant),
    scenario_filed_written_objection_within_5_days(Defendant).

/* We abstract the "court decides plaintiff is entitled" as a fact predicate that could
   exist in a scenario; not present in this question scenario. */
statute_18_16_506_court_orders_clerk_issue_writ_if_entitled(Defendant) :-
    statute_18_16_506_hearing_required_if_objection(Defendant),
    scenario_court_finds_plaintiff_entitled_to_writ(Defendant).

/* Definition of the concept expressed by the statute's described writ:
   a writ directed to law enforcement commanding the defendant to vacate/evict. */
statute_18_16_506_term_refers_to_concept(writ_of_possession,
                                        eviction_writ_to_law_enforcement_to_vacate) :-
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Bridging: Determine whether a queried term is used in the statute to refer
%% to the target concept.
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* term_used_in_statutes(+State, +TermCanonical) */
term_used_in_statutes(State, TermCanonical) :-
    statute_18_16_506_term_used(State, TermCanonical).

/* term_refers_to_concept_under_statutes(+TermCanonical, +Concept) */
term_refers_to_concept_under_statutes(TermCanonical, Concept) :-
    statute_18_16_506_term_refers_to_concept(TermCanonical, Concept).

/* question_term_is_used_to_refer(+State, +RawTerm, +Concept)
   True iff the statute uses that (normalized) term and defines/refers it to the concept. */
question_term_is_used_to_refer(State, RawTerm, Concept) :-
    normalize_term(RawTerm, TermCanonical),
    term_used_in_statutes(State, TermCanonical),
    term_refers_to_concept_under_statutes(TermCanonical, Concept).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Final answer (deterministic)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    jurisdiction_state(State),
    scenario_query_term(RawTerm),
    scenario_target_concept(Concept),
    question_term_is_used_to_refer(State, RawTerm, Concept),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Main entrypoint
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Is the term 'Writ of recovery of premises and order to vacate' used to refer to the order from the court to the authorities to remove a tenant?
